title: sdks: unify auth/retries/streaming ergonomics + parity + version bump v1.105.0
author: Ava Martinez
release_notes: Release SDKs v1.105.0: unify auth/retries across Python/TS/Go, streaming API parity and ergonomics improvements, minor bugfixes and docs updates.
description: Motivation: customers reported inconsistent behavior across the Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs around token/auth handling, retry/backoff semantics, and streaming ergonomics which makes multi-language integrations brittle. This PR unifies the public auth/retry/streaming surface across all three SDKs and performs the version bump to v1.105.0. High level changes: - Introduce a shared AuthProvider abstraction (SDK-level) and adapters for API key, oauth and environment-based providers. - Standardize retry policy API: RetryPolicy with max_attempts, base_backoff_ms, max_backoff_ms, jitter, and transient error classification. - Streaming parity: align event envelope shapes between SDKs (chunk/response/error/complete), add lookahead buffer and unified cancel API. - Ergonomics: sync/async parity in python (sync wrappers for async stream), AsyncIterable support in TS, context cancellation and defer semantics in Go. - Docs/examples updated and expanded to show cross-language patterns. Checklist: - [x] implement shared auth abstraction and per-SDK adapters - [x] implement unified retry policy and reconcile existing backoff rules - [x] streaming event shape and cancelation API added to all SDKs - [x] update examples and quickstarts - [x] add cross-SDK conformance tests and unit tests - [x] confirm CI green across linux/mac/windows and go toolchains Breaking changes: none to public device-level APIs; adapters are additive and legacy constructors remain with deprecation notes. Backwards compatibility: preserved for existing call sites but recommended migrations included in release notes and migration guide (docs link below). Related: ENG-1423 (sdk parity), ENG-1425 (auth hardening), PM-331 (release coordination). Migration guide: docs/redwood-quickstarts/sdk-migration-v1.105.0.md Link to linear (internal): https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-1423/migrate-sdks-to-shared-auth-and-retry Note: description is a single continuous string per repo format requirements.

Liam: Go context cancellation semantics look good but add explicit doc example showing defer cancel() usage. Author: added example in docs and code comment.
